    private static final java.util.Map<Long, java.util.List<net.minecraft.core.BlockPos>> BEACONS =
        new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private static long claveChunk(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel nivel, int cx, int cz) {
        long dim = nivel.m_46472_().m_135782_().hashCode();
        return (dim << 40) ^ ((long) cx << 20) ^ (cz & 0xFFFFFL);
    }

    private static java.util.List<net.minecraft.core.BlockPos> beaconsDeChunk(
        net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel nivel, int cx, int cz) {
        long clave = claveChunk(nivel, cx, cz);
        java.util.List<net.minecraft.core.BlockPos> lista = BEACONS.get(clave);
        if (lista != null) {
            return lista;
        }
        lista = new java.util.ArrayList<>(2);
        try {
            net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.LevelChunk chunk = nivel.m_6325_(cx, cz);
            if (chunk != null) {
                for (Object be : chunk.m_62954_().values()) {
                    if (be instanceof net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BeaconBlockEntity faro) {
                        lista.add(faro.m_58899_());
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignorado) {
            // chunk no cargado: se reintenta en la siguiente consulta
        }
        BEACONS.put(clave, lista);
        return lista;
    }

    /** Area de efecto del beacon: radio horizontal y todo el eje Y, independiente de los efectos del jugador. */
    private static boolean enAreaDeBeacon(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel nivel, double x, double z, double radio) {
        double radio2 = radio * radio;
        int c0x = (int) Math.floor(x - radio) >> 4;
        int c1x = (int) Math.floor(x + radio) >> 4;
        int c0z = (int) Math.floor(z - radio) >> 4;
        int c1z = (int) Math.floor(z + radio) >> 4;
        for (int cx = c0x; cx <= c1x; cx++) {
            for (int cz = c0z; cz <= c1z; cz++) {
                for (net.minecraft.core.BlockPos p : beaconsDeChunk(nivel, cx, cz)) {
                    double dx = p.m_123341_() + 0.5D - x;
                    double dz = p.m_123343_() + 0.5D - z;
                    if (dx * dx + dz * dz <= radio2) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** Al colocar o romper un bloque se invalida la cache del chunk (barato y conservador). */
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onBlockEvent(net.minecraftforge.event.level.BlockEvent event) {
        if (event.getLevel() instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel nivel && event.getPos() != null) {
            net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos = event.getPos();
            BEACONS.remove(claveChunk(nivel, pos.m_123341_() >> 4, pos.m_123343_() >> 4));
        }
    }

    /** La XP no existe como moneda en el pack: se cancelan todos los orbes al entrar al mundo. */
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onExperienceOrbJoin(net.minecraftforge.event.entity.EntityJoinLevelEvent event) {
        if (!EquipmentConfig.get().disable_experience_orbs) {
            return;
        }
        if (event.getEntity() instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.ExperienceOrb) {
            event.setCanceled(true);
        }
    }

    /** El beacon pacifica el area: sin spawns hostiles cerca de quien tiene Prisa (efecto de beacon). */
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onCheckSpawn(net.minecraftforge.event.entity.living.MobSpawnEvent.PositionCheck event) {
        if (!EquipmentConfig.get().beacon_pacify) {
            return;
        }
        if (!(event.getEntity() instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.Monster)) {
            return;
        }
        if (!(event.getLevel() instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel nivel)) {
            return;
        }
        if (enAreaDeBeacon(nivel, event.getX(), event.getZ(), EquipmentConfig.get().beacon_pacify_radius)) {
            event.setResult(net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.Event.Result.DENY);
        }
    }

    /** Unidad con la que se repara cada familia en el yunque (null = comportamiento vanilla). */
    private static Item repairUnitFor(ItemStack stack) {
        if (stack == null || stack.m_41619_()) {
            return null;
        }
        Item item = stack.m_41720_();
        if (item instanceof ArmorItem armor) {
            ArmorMaterial mat = armor.m_40401_();
            if (mat == ArmorMaterials.LEATHER) {
                return itemPorId("minecraft:leather");
            }
            if (mat == ArmorMaterials.CHAIN || mat == ArmorMaterials.IRON) {
                return itemPorId("minecraft:iron_ingot");
            }
            if (mat == ArmorMaterials.GOLD) {
                return itemPorId("minecraft:gold_ingot");
            }
            if (mat == ArmorMaterials.DIAMOND) {
                return itemPorId("minecraft:diamond");
            }
            if (mat == ArmorMaterials.NETHERITE) {
                return itemPorId("minecraft:netherite_ingot");
            }
            String familia = EquipmentPolicy.cataclysmFamily(stack);
            if ("ignitium".equals(familia)) {
                return itemPorId("cataclysm:ignitium_ingot");
            }
            if ("cursium".equals(familia)) {
                return itemPorId("cataclysm:cursium_ingot");
            }
            if ("monstrous".equals(familia)) {
                return itemPorId("minecraft:netherite_ingot");
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isNetheriteMageArmor(stack)) {
                return itemPorId("minecraft:netherite_ingot");
            }
            return null;
        }
        if (item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.BowItem
            || item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.CrossbowItem
            || item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.FishingRodItem) {
            return itemPorId("minecraft:string");
        }
        if (item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.ShieldItem) {
            return itemPorId("minecraft:oak_planks");
        }
        if (item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.ShearsItem) {
            return itemPorId("minecraft:iron_ingot");
        }
        if (item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.TieredItem tiered) {
            net.minecraft.world.item.Tier tier = tiered.m_43314_();
            if (tier == net.minecraft.world.item.Tiers.IRON) {
                return itemPorId("minecraft:iron_ingot");
            }
            if (tier == net.minecraft.world.item.Tiers.GOLD) {
                return itemPorId("minecraft:gold_ingot");
            }
            if (tier == net.minecraft.world.item.Tiers.DIAMOND) {
                return itemPorId("minecraft:diamond");
            }
            if (tier == net.minecraft.world.item.Tiers.NETHERITE) {
                return itemPorId("minecraft:netherite_ingot");
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean scrapRepair(ItemStack left, ItemStack right) {
        Item item = left.m_41720_();
        return right.m_41720_() == itemPorId("minecraft:netherite_scrap")
            && (EquipmentPolicy.isNetherite(item) || item instanceof ArmorItem armor && armor.m_40401_() == ArmorMaterials.NETHERITE);
    }

    public static float repairFractionFor(ItemStack left, ItemStack right) {
        return scrapRepair(left, right) ? EquipmentConfig.get().netherite_scrap_repair_fraction : repairFractionFor(left);
    }

    private static boolean matchesRepair(ItemStack left, ItemStack right) {
        if (scrapRepair(left, right)) return true;
        Item item = left.m_41720_();
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isWood(item)) return net.minecraft.world.item.Tiers.WOOD.m_6282_().test(right);
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isStone(item)) return net.minecraft.world.item.Tiers.STONE.m_6282_().test(right);
        Item unit = repairUnitFor(left);
        return unit != null && right.m_41720_() == unit;
    }

    /** Fraccion de durabilidad maxima que restaura una unidad de reparacion de esa familia. */
    public static float repairFractionFor(ItemStack stack) {
        if (stack == null || stack.m_41619_()) {
            return 0.0F;
        }
        EquipmentConfig cfg = EquipmentConfig.get();
        Item item = stack.m_41720_();
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isWood(item)) return cfg.wood_repair_fraction;
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isStone(item)) return cfg.stone_repair_fraction;
        if (item instanceof ArmorItem armor) {
            ArmorMaterial mat = armor.m_40401_();
            if (mat == ArmorMaterials.LEATHER) {
                return cfg.leather_repair_fraction;
            }
            if (mat == ArmorMaterials.CHAIN) {
                return cfg.chain_repair_fraction;
            }
            if (mat == ArmorMaterials.IRON) {
                return cfg.iron_repair_fraction;
            }
            if (mat == ArmorMaterials.GOLD) {
                return cfg.gold_repair_fraction;
            }
            if (mat == ArmorMaterials.DIAMOND) {
                return cfg.diamond_repair_fraction;
            }
            if (mat == ArmorMaterials.NETHERITE) {
                return cfg.netherite_repair_fraction;
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.cataclysmFamily(stack) != null) {
                return cfg.netherite_repair_fraction;
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isNetheriteMageArmor(stack)) {
                return cfg.netherite_repair_fraction;
            }
            return 0.0F;
        }
        if (item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.BowItem
            || item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.CrossbowItem
            || item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.FishingRodItem
            || item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.ShieldItem
            || item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.ShearsItem) {
            return cfg.simple_repair_fraction;
        }
        if (item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.TieredItem tiered) {
            net.minecraft.world.item.Tier tier = tiered.m_43314_();
            if (tier == net.minecraft.world.item.Tiers.IRON) {
                return cfg.iron_repair_fraction;
            }
            if (tier == net.minecraft.world.item.Tiers.GOLD) {
                return cfg.gold_repair_fraction;
            }
            if (tier == net.minecraft.world.item.Tiers.DIAMOND) {
                return cfg.diamond_repair_fraction;
            }
            if (tier == net.minecraft.world.item.Tiers.NETHERITE) {
                return cfg.netherite_repair_fraction;
            }
        }
        return 0.0F;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onPlayerTick(TickEvent.PlayerTickEvent event) {
        if (event.phase != TickEvent.Phase.END || event.player.m_9236_().m_5776_()) {
            return;
        }
        if (!EquipmentConfig.get().enable_mineral_set_bonuses) {
            return;
        }
        if (!(event.player instanceof ServerPlayer player)) {
            return;
        }

        if (EquipmentPolicy.getHeavyArmorPieceCount(player) == 0) IMPACTS.remove(player);
        CompoundTag data = player.getPersistentData();
        String currentSet = null;

        if (EquipmentPolicy.isWearingFullSet(player, ArmorMaterials.LEATHER)) {
            currentSet = "leather";
        } else if (EquipmentPolicy.isWearingFullSet(player, ArmorMaterials.CHAIN)) {
            currentSet = "chain";
        } else if (EquipmentPolicy.isWearingFullSet(player, ArmorMaterials.GOLD)) {
            currentSet = "gold";
        } else if (EquipmentPolicy.isWearingFullSet(player, ArmorMaterials.IRON)) {
            currentSet = "iron";
        } else if (EquipmentPolicy.isWearingFullSet(player, ArmorMaterials.DIAMOND)) {
            currentSet = "diamond";
        } else if (EquipmentPolicy.getNetheriteTierCount(player) >= 4) {
            currentSet = "netherite";
        }

        String lastSet = data.m_128461_("TheOptimizer_ActiveSet");
        if (currentSet != null && !currentSet.equals(lastSet)) {
            data.m_128359_("TheOptimizer_ActiveSet", currentSet);
            switch (currentSet) {
                case "leather" -> player.m_5661_(Component.m_237113_("§6✦ Estilo Explorador: §fAmortigua caídas, arcos potentes y ballesta veloz"), true);
                case "chain" -> player.m_5661_(Component.m_237113_("§7✦ Estilo Escaramuzador: §fProtección ante proyectiles y mayor velocidad"), true);
                case "gold" -> player.m_5661_(Component.m_237113_("§6✦ Estilo Arcano: §eMayor suerte pasiva y protección contra magia"), true);
                case "iron" -> player.m_5661_(Component.m_237113_("§f✦ Estilo Infantería: §bGran firmeza contra empuje y explosiones"), true);
                case "diamond" -> player.m_5661_(Component.m_237113_("§b✦ Blindaje de Élite (Diamante): §3Fuerte ante golpes de jefes; costosa contra hordas"), true);
                case "netherite" -> player.m_5661_(Component.m_237113_("§8✦ Blindaje de Élite (Nether): §cProtección térmica, contra Wither y golpes de jefes"), true);
            }
        } else if (currentSet == null && !lastSet.isEmpty()) {
            data.m_128473_("TheOptimizer_ActiveSet");
        }

        AttributeInstance blockReach = player.m_21051_(ForgeMod.BLOCK_REACH.get());
        if (blockReach != null) {
            float bonus = EquipmentCombatRules.ironArmorReach(EquipmentConfig.get(), EquipmentPolicy.getWornSetCount(player, ArmorMaterials.IRON));
            AttributeModifier existing = blockReach.m_22111_(IRON_ARMOR_REACH_UUID);
            if (existing != null && existing.m_22218_() != bonus) blockReach.m_22120_(IRON_ARMOR_REACH_UUID);
            if (bonus > 0 && (existing == null || existing.m_22218_() != bonus))
                blockReach.m_22118_(new AttributeModifier(IRON_ARMOR_REACH_UUID, "TheOptimizer Iron Armor Reach", bonus, AttributeModifier.Operation.ADDITION));
        }

        // Set de Cota de Malla: velocidad por piezas
        AttributeInstance speed = player.m_21051_(Attributes.f_22279_);
        if (speed != null) {
            int chainCount = EquipmentPolicy.getWornSetCount(player, ArmorMaterials.CHAIN);
            AttributeModifier targetMod = switch (chainCount) {
                case 1 -> CHAIN_SPEED_1;
                case 2 -> CHAIN_SPEED_2;
                case 3 -> CHAIN_SPEED_3;
                case 4 -> CHAIN_SPEED_4;
                default -> null;
            };
            AttributeModifier currentMod = speed.m_22111_(CHAIN_SPEED_UUID);
            if (targetMod != null) {
                if (currentMod == null || currentMod.m_22218_() != targetMod.m_22218_()) {
                    if (currentMod != null) {
                        speed.m_22120_(CHAIN_SPEED_UUID);
                    }
                    speed.m_22118_(targetMod);
                }
            } else if (currentMod != null) {
                speed.m_22120_(CHAIN_SPEED_UUID);
            }
        }

        // Set de Oro: Atributo nativo de Suerte (+1)
        AttributeInstance luck = player.m_21051_(Attributes.f_22286_);
        if (luck != null) {
            boolean hasFullGold = "gold".equals(currentSet);
            boolean hasMod = luck.m_22109_(GOLD_LUCK_MODIFIER);
            if (hasFullGold && !hasMod) {
                luck.m_22118_(GOLD_LUCK_MODIFIER);
            } else if (!hasFullGold && hasMod) {
                luck.m_22120_(GOLD_LUCK_UUID);
            }
        }

        // Elytra: volar cansa (cada tick de vuelo consume agotamiento)
        if (EquipmentConfig.get().elytra_flight_exhaustion > 0.0F && player.m_21255_()) {
            ItemStack pecho = player.m_6844_(EquipmentSlot.CHEST);
            if (esElytra(pecho)) {
                player.m_36399_(EquipmentConfig.get().elytra_flight_exhaustion);
            }
        }

        // Tunas de mago: cada pieza resta un 5 % de daño de arma (maximo 20 % a 4/4)
        int robes = EquipmentPolicy.getMageRobeCount(player);
        AttributeInstance attackDamage = player.m_21051_(Attributes.f_22281_);
        if (attackDamage != null) {
            double penalizacion = -EquipmentConfig.get().mage_weapon_damage_penalty * robes;
            AttributeModifier actual = attackDamage.m_22111_(MAGE_WEAPON_UUID);
            if (robes > 0) {
                if (actual == null || Math.abs(actual.m_22218_() - penalizacion) > 1.0E-4) {
                    if (actual != null) {
                        attackDamage.m_22120_(MAGE_WEAPON_UUID);
                    }
                    attackDamage.m_22118_(new AttributeModifier(
                        MAGE_WEAPON_UUID,
                        "TheOptimizer Mage Robe Weapon",
                        penalizacion,
                        AttributeModifier.Operation.MULTIPLY_TOTAL
                    ));
                }
            } else if (actual != null) {
                attackDamage.m_22120_(MAGE_WEAPON_UUID);
            }
        }

        // Limpiar cualquier efecto de poción residual de Suerte breve (<= 40 ticks)
        if (player.m_21023_(MobEffects.f_19621_)) {
            MobEffectInstance eff = player.m_21124_(MobEffects.f_19621_);
            if (eff != null && eff.m_19557_() <= 40) {
                player.m_21195_(MobEffects.f_19621_);
            }
        }
    }

        if (id == null || !"cataclysm".equals(id.m_135827_())) {

                addThematicDrop(event, "irons_spellbooks", "holy_rune", 2);
                addThematicDrop(event, "irons_spellbooks", "arcane_essence", 6);
                addThematicDrop(event, "irons_spellbooks", "epic_ink", 2);
            }
            case "maledictus" -> {
                addThematicDrop(event, "irons_spellbooks", "blood_rune", 2);
                addThematicDrop(event, "irons_spellbooks", "arcane_salvage", 2);
                addThematicDrop(event, "irons_spellbooks", "legendary_ink", 1);
            }
            case "scylla" -> {
                addThematicDrop(event, "irons_spellbooks", "evocation_rune", 2);
                addThematicDrop(event, "irons_spellbooks", "arcane_salvage", 2);
                addThematicDrop(event, "irons_spellbooks", "legendary_ink", 1);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void addThematicDrop(LivingDropsEvent event, String namespace, String path, int count) {
        Item item = ForgeRegistries.ITEMS.getValue(ResourceLocation.m_135820_(namespace + ":" + path));
        if (item != null && item != Items.f_41852_) { // Items.AIR
            LivingEntity entity = event.getEntity();
            ItemEntity itemEntity = new ItemEntity(
                entity.m_9236_(),
                entity.m_20185_(), entity.m_20186_(), entity.m_20189_(),
                new ItemStack(item, count)
            );
            itemEntity.m_32064_();
            event.getDrops().add(itemEntity);
        }
    }

    private static float scaleByPieces(int pieces, float s1, float s2, float s3, float s4) {
        if (pieces <= 0) {
            return 1.0F;
        }
        return switch (pieces) {
            case 1 -> s1;
            case 2 -> s2;
            case 3 -> s3;
            default -> s4;
        };
    }

    private static boolean isWitherDamage(DamageSource source) {
        return source.m_276093_(DamageTypes.f_268493_) || source.m_276093_(DamageTypes.f_268641_);
    }

    private static boolean isMagicDamage(DamageSource source) {
        if (source.m_276093_(DamageTypes.f_268515_) || source.m_276093_(DamageTypes.f_268530_)) {
            return true;
        }
        return source.m_269533_(DamageTypeTags.f_268731_) && !source.m_276093_(DamageTypes.f_268679_);
    }
    /**
     * La piedra no solo aturde: corta el estado interno de las familias con mecha, poción o conjuro.
     * Sin Goals ni escaneos: se resuelve en el instante del golpe.
     */
    private static void interrumpirConPiedra(LivingEntity victima) {
        if (victima instanceof Creeper creeper) {
            creeper.m_32283_(-1); // setSwellDir(-1): apaga la mecha
        } else if (victima instanceof Witch bruja && bruja.m_34161_()) {
            bruja.m_34163_(false); // deja de beber
            bruja.m_5810_();       // stopUsingItem
        } else if (victima instanceof SpellcasterIllager conjurador && conjurador.m_33736_()) {
            // IllagerSpell es protected: se corta con un stun largo en lugar de tocar el enum.
            conjurador.m_7292_(new MobEffectInstance(MobEffects.f_19597_, 40, 1));
            conjurador.m_5810_();
            ((SpellInterruptible) conjurador).theoptimizer$interruptSpell();
        }
    }

@Mod(EquipmentMod.MODID)
public final class EquipmentMod {

    public static final String MODID = "theoptimizer_equipment";

    @SuppressWarnings("removal")
    public EquipmentMod() {
        FMLJavaModLoadingContext.get().getModEventBus().addListener(this::onCommonSetup);
        MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS.register(EquipmentEvents.class);
    }

    private void onCommonSetup(FMLCommonSetupEvent event) {
        event.enqueueWork(() -> {
            EquipmentConfig.loadOrCreate();
            EquipmentPolicy.applyItemDurabilities();
        });
    }
}

    public static Tier getTier(Item item) {

    private static final java.util.Set<String> MAGE_EXCLUDED = java.util.Set.of(

    public static boolean isMageRobe(ItemStack stack) {

        ResourceLocation id = ForgeRegistries.ITEMS.getKey(stack.m_41720_());
        if (id == null) {

        String namespace = id.m_135827_();
        ArmorItem armor = (ArmorItem) stack.m_41720_();
        for (var entry : armor.m_7167_(armor.m_40402_()).entries()) {
            ResourceLocation attr = ForgeRegistries.ATTRIBUTES.getKey(entry.getKey());
            if (attr != null && attr.m_135815_().contains("spell_power") && entry.getValue().m_22218_() > 0) return true;
        }
        if (!"irons_spellbooks".equals(namespace) && !"alexs_caves_spellbooks".equals(namespace)) {
            return false;

        String path = id.m_135815_();
        if (MAGE_EXCLUDED.contains(path)) {

        String path = id == null ? "" : id.m_135815_();
        if (path.startsWith("pyromancer_") || path.startsWith("infernal_sorcerer_")) {
            return "Fuego";
        }
        if (path.startsWith("cryomancer_")) {
            return "Hielo";
        }
        if (path.startsWith("electromancer_")) {
            return "Rayo";
        }
        if (path.startsWith("priest_") || path.startsWith("paladin_")) {
            return "Sagrado";
        }
        if (path.startsWith("shadowwalker_")) {
            return "Ender";
        }
        if (path.startsWith("cultist_")) {

        if (path.startsWith("archevoker_")) {

        }
        if (path.startsWith("plagued_")) {

    /** Nombre legible del set: "wandering_magician" -> "Wandering Magician". */
    public static String mageSetName(ItemStack stack) {
        ResourceLocation id = ForgeRegistries.ITEMS.getKey(stack.m_41720_());
        String path = id == null ? "" : id.m_135815_();
        for (String suffix : MAGE_SUFFIXES) {
            if (path.endsWith(suffix)) {
                path = path.substring(0, path.length() - suffix.length());
                break;
            }
        }
        String[] partes = path.split("_");
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (String parte : partes) {
            if (parte.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            if (sb.length() > 0) {
                sb.append(' ');
            }
            sb.append(Character.toUpperCase(parte.charAt(0))).append(parte.substring(1));
        }
        return sb.length() == 0 ? "Mago" : sb.toString();
    }

        if (isNetheriteMageArmor(stack)) return true;

        ResourceLocation id = ForgeRegistries.ITEMS.getKey(stack.m_41720_());

        ArmorMaterial m = armor.m_40401_();
        ResourceLocation id = ForgeRegistries.ITEMS.getKey(stack.m_41720_());
        return m == ArmorMaterials.LEATHER || m == ArmorMaterials.CHAIN || m == ArmorMaterials.IRON
            || m == ArmorMaterials.GOLD || m == ArmorMaterials.DIAMOND || m == ArmorMaterials.NETHERITE
            || (id != null && "cataclysm".equals(id.m_135827_()));

    public static double attackSpeedModifier(ItemStack stack) {
        EquipmentConfig c = EquipmentConfig.get();
        String family = cataclysmFamily(stack);
        if ("cursium".equals(family)) return 0;
        if ("monstrous".equals(family)) return -c.monstrous_attack_speed_penalty;
        if (isNetheriteOrCataclysmIgnitium(stack)) return ArmorBalanceRules.pieceAttackPenalty(c.netherite_attack_speed_penalty);
        if (stack.m_41720_() instanceof ArmorItem a && a.m_40401_() == ArmorMaterials.DIAMOND)
            return ArmorBalanceRules.pieceAttackPenalty(c.diamond_attack_speed_penalty);
        return 0;
    }

    public static float colossalAbsorption(LivingEntity entity) {
        EquipmentConfig c = EquipmentConfig.get();
        float weight = 0;
        boolean monstrous = false;
        for (ItemStack stack : entity.m_6168_()) {
            if (!isHeavyArmorPiece(stack) && !isNetheriteMageArmor(stack)) continue;
            String family = cataclysmFamily(stack);
            if ("monstrous".equals(family)) monstrous = true;
            weight += "ignitium".equals(family) ? c.ignitium_colossal_multiplier : 1.0F;
        }
        return ArmorBalanceRules.colossalFraction(c, weight, monstrous);
    }

    public static void applyItemDurabilities() {
        EquipmentConfig cfg = EquipmentConfig.get();
        setDurability(Items.f_42430_, cfg.gold_tools_durability);
        setDurability(Items.f_42431_, cfg.gold_tools_durability);
        setDurability(Items.f_42432_, cfg.gold_tools_durability);
        setDurability(Items.f_42433_, cfg.gold_tools_durability);
        setDurability(Items.f_42434_, cfg.gold_tools_durability);

        setDurability(Items.f_42476_, 11 * cfg.gold_armor_multiplier);
        setDurability(Items.f_42477_, 16 * cfg.gold_armor_multiplier);
        setDurability(Items.f_42478_, 15 * cfg.gold_armor_multiplier);
        setDurability(Items.f_42479_, 13 * cfg.gold_armor_multiplier);

        setDurability(Items.f_42407_, 11 * cfg.gold_armor_multiplier);
        setDurability(Items.f_42408_, 16 * cfg.gold_armor_multiplier);
        setDurability(Items.f_42462_, 15 * cfg.gold_armor_multiplier);
        setDurability(Items.f_42463_, 13 * cfg.gold_armor_multiplier);
    }

    private static void setDurability(Item item, int maxDamage) {
        if (item == null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            ObfuscationReflectionHelper.setPrivateValue(Item.class, item, maxDamage, "f_41371_");
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
        }
    }

public final class EquipmentTooltipCards {
    public static final String HEADER = "§6⚡ §eAmpere";
    public static final String SHIFT_HINT = "§8Mantén §eShift §8para ver cifras y detalles";
    public enum Material { WOOD, STONE, IRON, GOLD, DIAMOND, NETHERITE, OTHER }
    public enum Armor { LEATHER, CHAIN, IRON, GOLD, DIAMOND, NETHERITE, IGNITIUM, CURSIUM, MONSTROUS, TURTLE, OTHER }
    public enum Tool { SWORD, AXE, PICKAXE, HARVEST, TRIDENT, BOW, CROSSBOW, SHIELD, FISHING_ROD, SHEARS }
    public record Card(String role, List<String> summary, List<String> details) {
        public Card { summary = List.copyOf(summary); details = List.copyOf(details); }
        public List<String> body(boolean shift) { return shift ? details : summary; }
    }
    public record ArmorView(Armor family, boolean mage, boolean lineage, boolean heavy, boolean boots,
                            int slot, float repair, double attackPenalty) { }
    public record WornPiece(Armor family, boolean mage, boolean lineage, boolean heavy, double attackModifier) { }
    /** Solo piezas vestidas: pasar el cursor por un objeto nunca lo añade al cálculo. */
    public record Outfit(List<WornPiece> pieces, double armor, int light, float colossal) {
        public Outfit { pieces = List.copyOf(pieces); }
        public int count(Armor family) { return (int) pieces.stream().filter(p -> p.family == family).count(); }
        public int lineage() { return (int) pieces.stream().filter(WornPiece::lineage).count(); }
        public int robes() { return (int) pieces.stream().filter(WornPiece::mage).count(); }
        public int heavy() { return (int) pieces.stream().filter(WornPiece::heavy).count(); }
        public int heavyNether() { return (int) pieces.stream().filter(p -> p.heavy && p.lineage).count(); }
        public double attackPenalty() {
            double factor = 1;
            for (WornPiece p : pieces) factor *= 1 + p.attackModifier;
            return 1 - factor;
        }
    }
    private EquipmentTooltipCards() { }

    public static Card armor(EquipmentConfig c, ArmorView p, Outfit equipped) {
        List<String> shortText = new ArrayList<>(), detail = new ArrayList<>();
        String role = switch (p.family) {
            case LEATHER -> "Explorador"; case CHAIN -> "Espeleólogo"; case IRON -> "Constructor e infantería";
            case GOLD -> "Alquimista"; case DIAMOND -> "Cazador"; case NETHERITE, IGNITIUM -> "Conquistador";
            case CURSIUM -> "Nether ligero"; case MONSTROUS -> "Coloso"; case TURTLE -> "Escafandra";
            default -> "Armadura";
        };
        if (p.mage) {
            role = "Mago";
            shortText.add("§7Potencia tus hechizos.");
            shortText.add("§cTus golpes cuerpo a cuerpo hacen menos daño.");
        }
        if (p.family == Armor.TURTLE) {
            shortText.add("§7Respiras y trabajas mejor bajo el agua.");
            detail.add("§7Más tiempo de respiración bajo el agua.");
            detail.add("§7Minas bajo el agua sin la penalización habitual.");
            return new Card(role, shortText, detail);
        }
        if (!c.enable_mineral_set_bonuses) {
            shortText.add("§8Bonificaciones de rol desactivadas.");
            detail.addAll(shortText);
            return new Card(role, shortText, detail);
        }
        switch (p.family) {
            case LEATHER -> {
                shortText.add("§7Amortigua caídas y facilita la exploración.");
                shortText.add("§7El conjunto completo potencia arco y ballesta.");
            }
            case CHAIN -> shortText.add("§7Más movilidad y protección ante proyectiles.");
            case IRON -> shortText.add("§7Aguanta mejor explosiones y empujones.");
            case GOLD -> shortText.add("§7Resiste magia; los piglins te dejan en paz.");
            case DIAMOND -> shortText.add("§7Amortigua golpes fuertes.");
            case NETHERITE -> shortText.add("§7Amortigua golpes fuertes; protege del Nether.");
            case IGNITIUM -> shortText.add("§7Prende al enemigo que te golpea de cerca.");
            case MONSTROUS -> shortText.add("§7Refuerza mucho la defensa ante golpes fuertes.");
            case CURSIUM -> shortText.add("§7Protección del Nether sin frenar tus ataques.");
            default -> { if (!p.mage) shortText.add("§7Defensa física equilibrada."); }
        }
        if (!p.mage && (p.family == Armor.LEATHER || p.family == Armor.CHAIN || p.family == Armor.IRON || p.family == Armor.GOLD))
            shortText.add("§cEsta pieza no amortigua golpes fuertes de enemigos.");
        if (p.boots) shortText.add("§7Botas ágiles sobre almas.");
        if (p.heavy) shortText.add("§cAtacas más lento; las hordas abren tu defensa.");
        if (p.heavy && c.kinetic_impact_exhaustion) shortText.add(p.repair > 0 && p.repair < 1
            ? "§cLos golpes gastan comida; reparación costosa."
            : "§cLos golpes consumen más reserva de comida.");
        if (p.lineage) shortText.add("§cLa oscuridad te vuelve más vulnerable.");
        if (p.family == Armor.MONSTROUS) shortText.add("§cTambién reduce tu velocidad al moverte.");
        if (p.family == Armor.CURSIUM) shortText.add("§cMenor defensa física y reparación costosa.");
        else if (p.repair > 0 && p.repair < 1 && !(p.heavy && c.kinetic_impact_exhaustion)) shortText.add("§cNecesita más material para repararse.");

        if (equipped == null) {
            detail.add("§8Sin jugador: no hay equipo actual que calcular.");
            detail.add(repairLine(p.repair));
            return new Card(role, shortText, detail);
        }
        detail.add("§7Armadura equipada ahora: " + number(equipped.armor) + " puntos.");
        detail.add("§8Valores del equipo que llevas puesto.");
        if (p.mage) detail.add("§cDaño cuerpo a cuerpo actual: −" + percent(c.mage_weapon_damage_penalty * equipped.robes()) + ".");
        switch (p.family) {
            case LEATHER -> {
                detail.add("§7Daño de caída: −" + percent(1 - EquipmentValues.leatherScale(equipped.count(Armor.LEATHER))) + ".");
                leatherRanged(detail, equipped.count(Armor.LEATHER) == ArmorBalanceRules.SET_PIECES);
            }
            case CHAIN -> {
                detail.add("§7Daño de proyectiles: −" + percent(1 - EquipmentValues.chainScale(equipped.count(Armor.CHAIN))) + ".");
                detail.add("§7Velocidad por la cota equipada: +" + percent(EquipmentValues.chainSpeed(equipped.count(Armor.CHAIN))) + ".");
            }
            case IRON -> {
                detail.add("§7Daño de explosiones: −" + percent(1 - EquipmentValues.elementalScale(equipped.count(Armor.IRON))) + ".");
                detail.add("§7Empuje recibido: −" + percent(1 - EquipmentValues.chainScale(equipped.count(Armor.IRON))) + ".");
                detail.add("§7Alcance de obra actual: +" + number(EquipmentCombatRules.ironArmorReach(c, equipped.count(Armor.IRON))) + " bloques.");
                detail.add("§8Se activa con " + c.iron_armor_reach_min_pieces + " piezas de hierro.");
            }
            case GOLD -> {
                detail.add("§7Daño mágico: −" + percent(1 - EquipmentValues.elementalScale(equipped.count(Armor.GOLD))) + ".");
                detail.add("§7Suerte por la armadura equipada: +" + number(equipped.count(Armor.GOLD) == ArmorBalanceRules.SET_PIECES ? EquipmentValues.GOLD_LUCK : 0) + ".");
            }
            default -> { }
        }
        if (p.heavy || p.lineage) {
            if (p.family == Armor.MONSTROUS)
                detail.add("§cMovimiento por Monstrous equipado: −" + percent(equipped.count(Armor.MONSTROUS) > 0 ? c.monstrous_movement_penalty : 0) + ".");
            {
                float absorb = equipped.colossal;
                detail.add("§7Coloso actual: absorbe " + percent(absorb) + " del excedente.");
                detail.add("§7Se activa sobre " + hearts(c.colossal_hit_threshold) + " corazones de daño.");
                float hit = c.colossal_hit_threshold * 2;
                float after = ArmorBalanceRules.colossal(hit, c.colossal_hit_threshold, absorb);
                detail.add("§8Ejemplo sin otros efectos:");
                detail.add("§7Un golpe de " + hearts(hit) + " corazones queda en " + hearts(after) + ".");
            }
            if (equipped.heavy() > 0) {
                detail.add("§cHorda: " + c.swarm_hit_count + " golpes en " + seconds(c.swarm_window_ticks) + ".");
                detail.add("§cDurante la brecha: " + number(equipped.armor * c.swarm_armor_fraction) + " puntos de armadura.");
            } else detail.add("§7Brecha inactiva: no llevas piezas pesadas.");
            detail.add("§cAtaque por las armaduras equipadas: −" + percent(equipped.attackPenalty()) + ".");
            if (c.kinetic_impact_exhaustion && equipped.heavy() > 0) {
                float hit = c.colossal_hit_threshold * 2;
                detail.add("§8Comida equivalente por un golpe de " + hearts(hit) + " corazones:");
                detail.add("§c" + food(ArmorBalanceRules.impactExhaustion(c, hit, equipped.heavyNether(), equipped.heavy())) + " muslitos con tu equipo actual.");
            }
        }
        if (p.family == Armor.IGNITIUM) {
            detail.add(equipped.count(Armor.IGNITIUM) > 0 ? "§7Contraataque ígneo equipado." : "§8Contraataque inactivo: no llevas Ignitium.");
            detail.add("§7Contraataque: prende al atacante " + number(c.ignitium_retaliation_seconds) + " s.");
            detail.add("§7Tiempo entre contraataques: " + seconds(c.ignitium_retaliation_cooldown_ticks) + ".");
        }
        if (p.family == Armor.CURSIUM) detail.add("§7Esta pieza no aporta Coloso ni activa brecha.");
        if (p.lineage) {
            float fire = 1 - ArmorBalanceRules.thermalScale(c.netherite_fire_reduction, equipped.lineage());
            float wither = 1 - ArmorBalanceRules.thermalScale(c.netherite_wither_reduction, equipped.lineage());
            if (fire >= 1 && wither >= 1)
                detail.add("§7Equipo actual: inmune al fuego y marchitamiento.");
            else {
                detail.add("§7Daño de fuego actual: −" + percent(fire) + ".");
                detail.add("§7Marchitamiento actual: −" + percent(wither) + ".");
            }
            detail.add("§7Empuje: +" + percent(c.netherite_knockback_resistance * equipped.lineage() / ArmorBalanceRules.SET_PIECES) + " por el linaje equipado.");
            detail.add("§cDaño por oscuridad ahora: +" + percent(ArmorBalanceRules.lowLightMultiplier(c, equipped.lineage(), equipped.light) - 1) + ".");
            detail.add("§8Se activa con luz menor que " + c.netherite_low_light_threshold + ".");
        }
        detail.add(repairLine(p.repair));
        if (c.netherite_scrap_repair_fraction > 0 && (p.family == Armor.MONSTROUS || p.family == Armor.NETHERITE && !p.mage))
            detail.add("§7Fragmento de netherita: repara " + percent(c.netherite_scrap_repair_fraction) + ".");
        return new Card(role, shortText, detail);
    }

    public static Card tool(EquipmentConfig c, Material m, Tool kind, float repair, float undeadBonus) {
        return tool(c, m, kind, repair, undeadBonus, true, false);
    }
    public static Card tool(EquipmentConfig c, Material m, Tool kind, float repair, float undeadBonus, boolean returns, boolean fullLeather) {
        List<String> s = new ArrayList<>(), d = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean combat = kind == Tool.SWORD || kind == Tool.AXE;
        boolean harvest = kind == Tool.AXE || kind == Tool.PICKAXE || kind == Tool.HARVEST;
        if (kind == Tool.BOW || kind == Tool.CROSSBOW || kind == Tool.SHIELD || kind == Tool.FISHING_ROD || kind == Tool.SHEARS) {
            switch (kind) {
                case BOW, CROSSBOW -> {
                    s.add("§7Arma de distancia; combina con cuero completo.");
                    s.add("§cNecesita munición y desgasta el arma al disparar.");
                    leatherRanged(d, fullLeather);
                    d.add("§7Cada cuerda restaura " + percent(repair) + " de durabilidad.");
                }
                case SHIELD -> {
                    s.add("§7Bloquea ataques de frente.");
                    s.add("§cBloquear desgasta el escudo; las hachas pueden desactivarlo.");
                    d.add("§7Cada tablón de roble restaura " + percent(repair) + " de durabilidad.");
                }
                case FISHING_ROD -> {
                    s.add("§7Pesca y recoge el anzuelo de forma normal.");
                    s.add("§cRecoger la caña consume durabilidad.");
                    d.add("§7Cada cuerda restaura " + percent(repair) + " de durabilidad.");
                }
                case SHEARS -> {
                    s.add("§7Corta vegetación con más alcance y menor desgaste.");
                    s.add("§cFuera de las hojas sigue consumiendo durabilidad.");
                    d.add("§7Alcance adicional a bloques: " + number(EquipmentValues.IRON_REACH) + ".");
                    d.add("§7Desgaste medio reducido a la mitad; sin trabajo en área.");
                    if (c.leaves_free_durability) d.add("§7Las hojas no desgastan las tijeras.");
                    d.add(repairLine(repair));
                }
                default -> { }
            }
            return new Card(kind == Tool.SHIELD ? "Defensa" : kind == Tool.FISHING_ROD ? "Pesca" : kind == Tool.SHEARS ? "Recolección" : "Distancia", s, d);
        }
        if (kind == Tool.TRIDENT) {
            s.add(returns ? "§7Vuelve al lanzarlo y favorece el combate acuático." : "§7Propúlsate en agua o lluvia; no vuelve al lanzarlo.");
            s.add("§cHace menos daño en tierra firme.");
            d.add("§7Daño con agua o lluvia: +" + percent(c.trident_wet_bonus) + ".");
            d.add("§cDaño en seco: −" + percent(c.trident_dry_penalty) + ".");
            if (returns) d.add("§7Regresa a su dueño después de lanzarlo.");
            else d.add("§7Impulso acuático equipado: sin retorno automático.");
            d.add("§8El cambio de daño por humedad solo afecta al cuerpo a cuerpo.");
        } else {
            switch (m) {
                case WOOD -> {
                    if (combat) {
                        s.add("§7Ágil y eficaz contra arañas y otros artrópodos.");
                        d.add("§7Daño a artrópodos: " + number(c.wood_arthropod_multiplier) + " veces el habitual.");
                        d.add("§7Velocidad de ataque adicional: +" + number(EquipmentValues.WOOD_WEAPON_SPEED) + "/s.");
                        d.add("§7Empuje al golpear: +" + number(EquipmentValues.WOOD_WEAPON_KNOCKBACK) + ".");
                    }
                    if (harvest) {
                        s.add("§7Cuida las hojas y ayuda con la vegetación.");
                        d.add("§7Velocidad en madera y cultivos: +" + percent(c.wood_gather_bonus) + ".");
                        if (c.leaves_free_durability) d.add("§7Las hojas no desgastan la herramienta.");
                        d.add("§7Polvo de hueso al recolectar vegetación: " + percent(EquipmentValues.WOOD_BONEMEAL_CHANCE) + ".");
                    }
                }
                case STONE -> {
                    if (combat) {
                        s.add("§7Empuja y corta acciones de tus enemigos.");
                        d.add("§7Ralentiza al golpear durante " + seconds(c.stone_stun_ticks) + ".");
                        d.add("§7Interrumpe mechas, pociones y conjuros.");
                        d.add("§7Resistencia al empuje: +" + percent(EquipmentValues.STONE_KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE) + ".");
                        d.add("§7Empuje al golpear: +" + number(EquipmentValues.STONE_EXTRA_KNOCKBACK
                            + EquipmentValues.STONE_INNATE_KNOCKBACK_LEVEL * EquipmentValues.VANILLA_KNOCKBACK_PER_LEVEL) + ".");
                    }
                    if (harvest) {
                        s.add(c.stone_quarry_free_durability ? "§7Cantera sin desgaste y buen ritmo en piedra y menas." : "§7Buen ritmo de trabajo en piedra y menas.");
                        s.add("§cLas menas y otros materiales sí gastan durabilidad.");
                        d.add("§7Velocidad en piedra y menas: +" + percent(c.stone_gather_bonus) + ".");
                        if (c.stone_quarry_free_durability) {
                            d.add("§7Sin desgaste en roca común de cantera.");
                            d.add("§8Piedra, adoquines, pizarra, toba, andesita,");
                            d.add("§8diorita, granito y roca del Nether.");
                        }
                    }
                }
                case IRON -> {
                    s.add(combat ? "§7Más alcance para mantener al enemigo a raya." : "§7Más alcance para trabajar en áreas amplias.");
                    d.add("§7Alcance adicional: " + number(EquipmentValues.IRON_REACH) + " bloques.");
                    if (kind == Tool.SWORD) d.add("§7Golpea a varios enemigos con el barrido.");
                    if (kind == Tool.AXE) {
                        s.add("§7Rompe escudos; esprintar refuerza ese golpe.");
                        s.add("§cRomper guardia consume comida y desgaste extra.");
                        d.add("§7Escudo enemigo desactivado durante " + seconds(c.iron_axe_shield_disable_ticks) + ".");
                        d.add("§7Al romper guardia esprintando: daño +" + percent(c.iron_axe_sprint_damage_bonus) + ".");
                        d.add("§cCoste por activación: " + food(c.iron_axe_exhaustion_cost) + " muslitos de reserva");
                        d.add("§cy " + c.iron_axe_extra_wear + " de durabilidad extra.");
                    }
                    if (harvest) {
                        s.add("§7Trabaja en área y se desgasta más despacio.");
                        s.add("§cEl área consume durabilidad por cada bloque.");
                        d.add("§7Área de trabajo: " + EquipmentValues.IRON_MINING_WIDTH + " por " + EquipmentValues.IRON_MINING_WIDTH + " bloques.");
                        d.add("§7Cada uso gasta la mitad de durabilidad, de media.");
                        d.add("§7Agáchate para trabajar un único bloque.");
                    }
                }
                case GOLD -> {
                    if (combat) { s.add("§7Especialista contra enemigos no muertos."); d.add("§7Daño adicional a no muertos: " + hearts(undeadBonus) + " corazones."); }
                    if (harvest) { s.add("§7Funde directamente los materiales que recoge."); d.add("§7Funde los materiales adecuados para esta herramienta."); }
                    s.add("§7Más suerte; los piglins te dejan en paz.");
                    d.add("§7Suerte adicional: +" + number(EquipmentValues.GOLD_LUCK) + ".");
                }
                case DIAMOND -> {
                    if (combat) {
                        s.add("§7Precisión y golpes críticos con mayor alcance.");
                        s.add("§cPierde fuerza contra enemigos bien acorazados.");
                        d.add("§7Crítico: " + percent(c.diamond_crit_chance) + " de probabilidad.");
                        d.add("§7Daño crítico: " + number(c.diamond_crit_multiplier) + " veces el habitual.");
                        d.add("§cDaño contra " + number(c.diamond_armored_target_threshold) + " o más de armadura: −" + percent(c.diamond_armored_damage_penalty) + ".");
                    }
                    if (harvest) { s.add("§7Conserva los bloques en su forma original."); d.add("§7Extrae bloques completos en lugar de sus materiales."); }
                    d.add("§7Alcance adicional: " + number(EquipmentValues.ELITE_REACH) + " bloque.");
                    if (kind == Tool.PICKAXE) d.add("§7Pizarra y obsidiana: " + number(EquipmentValues.FAST_MINING_MULTIPLIER) + " veces más rápido.");
                }
                case NETHERITE -> {
                    if (combat) {
                        s.add("§7Castiga a enemigos con armadura.");
                        d.add("§7Daño contra armadura: +" + percent(c.netherite_armored_damage_bonus) + ".");
                    }
                    if (harvest) { s.add("§7Extrae más recursos al trabajar."); d.add("§7Aumenta los recursos que deja cada bloque compatible."); }
                    s.add("§7Mayor alcance para combatir y trabajar.");
                    d.add("§7Alcance adicional: " + number(EquipmentValues.ELITE_REACH) + " bloque.");
                    if (kind == Tool.PICKAXE) d.add("§7Escombros ancestrales: " + number(EquipmentValues.FAST_MINING_MULTIPLIER) + " veces más rápido.");
                }
                default -> { }
            }
        }
        if (m == Material.WOOD || m == Material.STONE && !harvest || m == Material.GOLD) {
            s.add("§cSu durabilidad limita las expediciones largas.");
            int durability = m == Material.WOOD ? c.wood_tool_durability : m == Material.STONE ? c.stone_tool_durability : c.gold_tools_durability;
            d.add("§7Durabilidad base: " + durability + " usos.");
        }
        if (repair > 0 && repair < 1) s.add("§cNecesita más material para repararse.");
        d.add(repairLine(repair));
        if (m == Material.NETHERITE && c.netherite_scrap_repair_fraction > 0) d.add("§7Fragmento de netherita: repara " + percent(c.netherite_scrap_repair_fraction) + ".");
        return new Card(kind == Tool.TRIDENT ? "Profundidades" : combat ? "Combate" : "Recolección", s, d);
    }
    public static String repairLine(float fraction) {
        return fraction > 0 ? "§7Cada material de reparación restaura " + percent(fraction) + "." : "§7Reparación estándar en yunque.";
    }
    private static void leatherRanged(List<String> lines, boolean active) {
        lines.add(active ? "§7Sinergia de cuero completo activa:" : "§8Sinergia inactiva: requiere cuero completo.");
        lines.add("§7Velocidad de proyectil actual: +" + percent(active ? EquipmentValues.LEATHER_PROJECTILE_SPEED_MULTIPLIER - 1 : 0) + ".");
        lines.add("§7Ritmo de carga actual: " + number(active ? 1 + EquipmentValues.LEATHER_CROSSBOW_EXTRA_CHARGE : 1) + " veces el normal.");
        lines.add("§7Perfora " + (active ? EquipmentValues.LEATHER_CROSSBOW_PIERCING : 0) + " objetivo adicional.");
    }
}

final class EquipmentTooltipCompat {
    private EquipmentTooltipCompat() { }
    static void appendModTooltips(Item item, List<Component> tooltip) {
        var id = ForgeRegistries.ITEMS.getKey(item);
        if (id == null) return;
        String text = switch (id.toString()) {
            case "minecraft:enchanting_table" -> "§7Bloque decorativo; no se puede usar para mejorar equipo.";
            case "alexsmobs:transmutation_table" -> "§7Cada transmutación consume " + EquipmentValues.TRANSMUTATION_AMETHYST_COST + " fragmento de amatista.";
            case "alexsmobs:rocky_chestplate" -> "§7Contraataque al recibir un golpe: " + TooltipText.hearts(EquipmentValues.ROCKY_RETALIATION_DAMAGE) + " corazones de daño.";
            default -> null;
        };
        if (text != null) {
            tooltip.add(Component.m_237113_(""));
            tooltip.add(Component.m_237113_(EquipmentTooltipCards.HEADER));
            tooltip.add(Component.m_237113_(" §8• " + text));
        }
    }
}

public final class EquipmentTooltips {
    private EquipmentTooltips() { }

    public static void append(ItemTooltipEvent event) {
        ItemStack stack = event.getItemStack();
        if (stack.m_41619_()) return;
        Item item = stack.m_41720_();
        Player player = event.getEntity();
        EquipmentConfig c = EquipmentConfig.get();
        List<Component> lines = event.getToolTip();
        Card card = null;
        String label = item.m_41466_().getString();
        int worn = 0;
        EquipmentSlot slot = EquipmentSlot.MAINHAND;
        boolean armor = item instanceof ArmorItem;
        if (item instanceof ArmorItem a && (EquipmentPolicy.normalizedPhysical(stack)
            || EquipmentPolicy.isMageRobe(stack) || a.m_40401_() == ArmorMaterials.TURTLE)) {
            Armor family = armorFamily(stack, a);
            boolean mage = EquipmentPolicy.isMageRobe(stack);
            boolean lineage = EquipmentPolicy.isNetheriteOrCataclysmIgnitium(stack);
            worn = mage ? EquipmentPolicy.getMageRobeCount(player) : lineage
                ? EquipmentPolicy.getNetheriteTierCount(player) : EquipmentPolicy.getWornSetCount(player, a.m_40401_());
            slot = a.m_40402_();
            card = EquipmentTooltipCards.armor(c, new ArmorView(family, mage, lineage,
                EquipmentPolicy.isHeavyArmorPiece(stack), EquipmentPolicy.isNetheriteBoots(item),
                EquipmentPolicy.armorSlot(a), EquipmentEvents.repairFractionFor(stack), EquipmentPolicy.attackSpeedModifier(stack)), outfit(player));
            label = mage ? EquipmentPolicy.mageSetName(stack) : armorLabel(family, label);
        } else if (c.enable_tool_attributes) {
            Material material = material(item);
            Tool kind = specialKind(item);
            if (kind == null && (item instanceof DiggerItem || item instanceof SwordItem) && material != Material.OTHER)
                kind = EquipmentPolicy.isSword(item) ? Tool.SWORD : EquipmentPolicy.isAxe(item) ? Tool.AXE
                    : EquipmentPolicy.isPickaxe(item) ? Tool.PICKAXE : Tool.HARVEST;
            if (kind != null) {
                boolean returns = net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.EnchantmentHelper.m_44932_(stack) == 0;
                boolean leather = c.enable_mineral_set_bonuses && EquipmentPolicy.isWearingFullSet(player, ArmorMaterials.LEATHER);
                card = EquipmentTooltipCards.tool(c, material, kind, EquipmentEvents.repairFractionFor(stack),
                    EquipmentCombatRules.goldBonus(c.gold_smite_level, 0), returns, leather);
                label = switch (kind) {
                    case TRIDENT -> "Tridente"; case BOW -> "Arco"; case CROSSBOW -> "Ballesta";
                    case SHIELD -> "Escudo"; case FISHING_ROD -> "Caña"; case SHEARS -> "Tijeras";
                    default -> materialLabel(material);
                };
            }
        }
        if (card != null) {
            Set<String> owned = ownedBonusKeys(stack, slot, armor);
            lines.removeIf(line -> TooltipComponents.replaced(line, owned));
            // Alinea azul, verde y rojo conservando estilos y atributos de otros mods.
            lines.replaceAll(TooltipComponents::align);
            boolean shift = Screen.m_96638_();
            lines.add(Component.m_237113_(""));
            String count = armor && player != null ? " §7(" + worn + "/" + EquipmentCombatRules.rolePieces(item instanceof ArmorItem a && a.m_40401_() == ArmorMaterials.TURTLE) + ")" : "";
            lines.add(Component.m_237113_(HEADER + " §8· §f" + label + " §8— " + card.role() + count));
            for (String text : card.body(shift)) lines.add(Component.m_237113_(" §8• " + text));
            lines.add(Component.m_237113_(shift ? "§8Suelta Shift para volver al resumen" : SHIFT_HINT));
        }
        EquipmentTooltipCompat.appendModTooltips(item, lines);
    }

    private static Outfit outfit(Player player) {
        if (player == null) return null;
        List<WornPiece> pieces = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ItemStack stack : player.m_6168_()) {
            if (stack.m_41619_() || !(stack.m_41720_() instanceof ArmorItem armor)) continue;
            pieces.add(new WornPiece(armorFamily(stack, armor), EquipmentPolicy.isMageRobe(stack),
                EquipmentPolicy.isNetheriteOrCataclysmIgnitium(stack), EquipmentPolicy.isHeavyArmorPiece(stack),
                EquipmentConfig.get().enable_mineral_set_bonuses ? EquipmentPolicy.attackSpeedModifier(stack) : 0));
        }
        return new Outfit(pieces, player.m_21133_(Attributes.f_22284_),
            player.m_9236_().m_46803_(player.m_20183_()), EquipmentPolicy.colossalAbsorption(player));
    }

    private static Set<String> ownedBonusKeys(ItemStack stack, EquipmentSlot slot, boolean armor) {
        Map<Attribute, String> keys = new HashMap<>();
        keys.put(ForgeMod.ENTITY_REACH.get(), "forge.entity_reach");
        keys.put(ForgeMod.BLOCK_REACH.get(), "forge.block_reach");
        keys.put(Attributes.f_22286_, "attribute.name.generic.luck");
        if (armor && EquipmentConfig.get().enable_mineral_set_bonuses) {
            keys.put(Attributes.f_22278_, "attribute.name.generic.knockback_resistance");
            keys.put(Attributes.f_22283_, "attribute.name.generic.attack_speed");
            keys.put(Attributes.f_22279_, "attribute.name.generic.movement_speed");
        }
        Set<String> result = new HashSet<>();
        for (var entry : stack.m_41638_(slot).asMap().entrySet()) {
            String key = keys.get(entry.getKey());
            if (key != null && !entry.getValue().isEmpty()
                && entry.getValue().stream().allMatch(mod -> mod.m_22214_().startsWith("TheOptimizer "))) result.add(key);
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static Tool specialKind(Item item) {
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isTrident(item)) return Tool.TRIDENT;
        if (item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.BowItem) return Tool.BOW;
        if (item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.CrossbowItem) return Tool.CROSSBOW;
        if (item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.ShieldItem) return Tool.SHIELD;
        if (item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.FishingRodItem) return Tool.FISHING_ROD;
        if (item instanceof net.minecraft.world.item.ShearsItem) return Tool.SHEARS;
        return null;
    }

    private static Material material(Item item) {
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isWood(item)) return Material.WOOD;
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isStone(item)) return Material.STONE;
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isGold(item)) return Material.GOLD;
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isIron(item)) return Material.IRON;
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isDiamond(item)) return Material.DIAMOND;
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isNetherite(item)) return Material.NETHERITE;
        return Material.OTHER;
    }

    private static Armor armorFamily(ItemStack stack, ArmorItem item) {
        String family = EquipmentPolicy.cataclysmFamily(stack);
        if ("ignitium".equals(family)) return Armor.IGNITIUM;
        if ("cursium".equals(family)) return Armor.CURSIUM;
        if ("monstrous".equals(family)) return Armor.MONSTROUS;
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isNetheriteOrCataclysmIgnitium(stack)) return Armor.NETHERITE;
        var m = item.m_40401_();
        if (m == ArmorMaterials.LEATHER) return Armor.LEATHER;
        if (m == ArmorMaterials.CHAIN) return Armor.CHAIN;
        if (m == ArmorMaterials.IRON) return Armor.IRON;
        if (m == ArmorMaterials.GOLD) return Armor.GOLD;
        if (m == ArmorMaterials.DIAMOND) return Armor.DIAMOND;
        if (m == ArmorMaterials.TURTLE) return Armor.TURTLE;
        return Armor.OTHER;
    }

    private static String armorLabel(Armor a, String fallback) {
        return switch (a) {
            case LEATHER -> "Cuero"; case CHAIN -> "Cota de malla"; case IRON -> "Hierro"; case GOLD -> "Oro";
            case DIAMOND -> "Diamante"; case NETHERITE -> "Netherita"; case IGNITIUM -> "Ignitium";
            case CURSIUM -> "Cursium"; case MONSTROUS -> "Monstrous"; case TURTLE -> "Tortuga"; default -> fallback;
        };
    }
    private static String materialLabel(Material m) {
        return switch (m) {
            case WOOD -> "Madera"; case STONE -> "Piedra"; case IRON -> "Hierro"; case GOLD -> "Oro";
            case DIAMOND -> "Diamante"; case NETHERITE -> "Netherita"; default -> "Herramienta";
        };
    }
}

public final class LowHungerWarning {
    public static final int FOOD_ROW = 27;
    public static final int ICON_SIZE = 9;
    public static final int VANILLA_FOOD_BASELINE = 39;
    private static final int EMPTY_U = 16;
    private static final int FULL_U = 52;
    private static final int HALF_U = 61;
    private static final int HUNGER_EMPTY_U = EMPTY_U + 13 * ICON_SIZE;
    private static final int HUNGER_U_OFFSET = 36;
    private static final long VANILLA_HUD_SEED_MULTIPLIER = 312871L;

    private LowHungerWarning() { }

    public static boolean active(EquipmentConfig c, int food) {
        return c.low_hunger_warning && food >= 0 && food <= c.low_hunger_warning_food;
    }

    public static int interval(EquipmentConfig c, int food, int baseTicks) {
        return Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.max(1, baseTicks)
            * (food <= c.low_hunger_critical_food ? c.low_hunger_critical_interval_multiplier : 1.0F)));
    }

    public static boolean foodIcon(int u, int v, int width, int height) {
        return v == FOOD_ROW && width == ICON_SIZE && height == ICON_SIZE
            && (u == EMPTY_U || u == FULL_U || u == HALF_U || u == HUNGER_EMPTY_U
                || u == FULL_U + HUNGER_U_OFFSET || u == HALF_U + HUNGER_U_OFFSET);
    }

    public static int hungerU(int u) {
        return switch (u) {
            case EMPTY_U -> HUNGER_EMPTY_U;
            case FULL_U, HALF_U -> u + HUNGER_U_OFFSET;
            default -> u;
        };
    }

    /** Mismo rango aleatorio vanilla (-1..1), estable entre frames del mismo tick. */
    public static int jitter(EquipmentConfig c, int food, long tick, int x) {
        if (!active(c, food) || tick % interval(c, food, c.low_hunger_jitter_interval_ticks) != 0) return 0;
        return new Random(tick * VANILLA_HUD_SEED_MULTIPLIER + x).nextInt(3) - 1;
    }

    public static final class GrowlTimer {
        private int elapsed;

        /** Llamar exactamente una vez por tick del jugador local, nunca desde render. */
        public boolean tick(EquipmentConfig c, int food, boolean eligible) {
            if (!eligible || food <= 0 || !active(c, food)) {
                elapsed = 0;
                return false;
            }
            if (++elapsed < interval(c, food, c.low_hunger_growl_interval_ticks)) return false;
            elapsed = 0;
            return true;
        }

        public void reset() { elapsed = 0; }
    }
}

public final class MiningDurability {
    public static final Set<String> QUARRY = Set.of("minecraft:stone", "minecraft:cobblestone", "minecraft:deepslate",
        "minecraft:cobbled_deepslate", "minecraft:tuff", "minecraft:andesite", "minecraft:diorite",
        "minecraft:granite", "minecraft:netherrack");
    private static final ThreadLocal<ItemStack> FREE_MINING = new ThreadLocal<>();
    private MiningDurability() { }

    public static boolean free(EquipmentConfig c, boolean harvestTool, boolean sword, boolean shears,
                               boolean stone, boolean leaves, String blockId) {
        return c.leaves_free_durability && leaves && (harvestTool || sword || shears)
            || c.enable_tool_attributes && c.stone_quarry_free_durability && harvestTool && stone && QUARRY.contains(blockId);
    }
    public static boolean shouldSkip(Item item, BlockState state) {
        var id = ForgeRegistries.BLOCKS.getKey(state.m_60734_());
        return free(EquipmentConfig.get(), item instanceof DiggerItem, item instanceof SwordItem,
            item instanceof ShearsItem, EquipmentPolicy.isStone(item), state.m_204336_(BlockTags.f_13035_), id == null ? "" : id.toString());
    }
    public static boolean dispatch(ItemStack stack, boolean free, BooleanSupplier mining) {
        ItemStack previous = FREE_MINING.get();
        if (free) FREE_MINING.set(stack);
        try { return mining.getAsBoolean(); }
        finally {
            if (previous == null) FREE_MINING.remove(); else FREE_MINING.set(previous);
        }
    }
    public static boolean suppressed(ItemStack stack) { return FREE_MINING.get() == stack; }
}

    @Inject(method = "m_7366_", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)

@Mixin(EnchantmentHelper.class)
public abstract class EnchantmentHelperMixin {

    @Unique
    private static int theoptimizer$getInnateLevel(Enchantment enchantment, Item item) {
        if (enchantment == null || item == null) {
            return 0;
        }
        // 1. Diamante: Toque de Seda como atributo interno (no expuesto en lista de encantamientos)
        if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44985_ && EquipmentPolicy.isDiamondHarvestTool(item)) {
            return 1;
        }
        // 2. Netherita: Fortuna 3
        if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44987_ && EquipmentPolicy.isNetheriteHarvestTool(item)) {
            return 3;
        }
        // 3. Netherita Botas: Soul Speed 2
        if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44976_ && EquipmentPolicy.isNetheriteBoots(item)) {
            return 2;
        }
        // 4. Cuero Botas: Feather Falling 4
        if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44967_ && EquipmentPolicy.isLeatherBoots(item)) {
            return 4;
        }
        // 5. Cuero Botas: Leaf Walker 1
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isLeafWalker(enchantment) && EquipmentPolicy.isLeatherBoots(item)) {
            return 1;
        }
        // 6. Cuero Grebas: Swift Sneak 3
        if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_220304_ && EquipmentPolicy.isLeatherLeggings(item)) {
            return 3;
        }
        // 7. Tortuga Casco: Respiration 3 & Aqua Affinity 1
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isTurtleHelmet(item)) {
            if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44970_) {
                return 3;
            }
            if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44971_) {
                return 1;
            }
        }
        // 8. Alex's Mobs Flying Fish Boots: Depth Strider 3
        if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44973_ && EquipmentPolicy.isFlyingFishBoots(item)) {
            return 3;
        }
        // 9. Alex's Mobs Rocky Chestplate: Thorns 3
        if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44972_ && EquipmentPolicy.isRockyChestplate(item)) {
            return 3;
        }
        // 10. Piedra Combate: Knockback 1
        if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44980_ && EquipmentPolicy.isStone(item) && EquipmentPolicy.isCombatWeapon(item)) {
            return EquipmentValues.STONE_INNATE_KNOCKBACK_LEVEL;
        }
        // 11. Hierro Espada: Sweeping Edge 3
        if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44983_ && EquipmentPolicy.isIron(item) && EquipmentPolicy.isSword(item)) {
            return 3;
        }
        // 12. Oro Combate: Smite (nivel configurable)
        if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44978_ && EquipmentPolicy.isGold(item) && EquipmentPolicy.isCombatWeapon(item)) {
            return EquipmentConfig.get().gold_smite_level;
        }
        // 13. Tridente: Loyalty 3 & Impaling 5
        if (EquipmentPolicy.isTrident(item)) {
            if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44955_) {
                return 3;
            }
            if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44956_) {
                return 5;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    @Inject(method = "m_44843_", at = @At("RETURN"), cancellable = true)
    private static void theoptimizer$toolInnateEnchantmentLevel(Enchantment enchantment, ItemStack stack,
                                                                CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if (!EquipmentConfig.get().enable_tool_attributes) {
            return;
        }
        if (stack != null && !stack.m_41619_()) {
            Item item = stack.m_41720_();
            // Tridente con Riptide no recibe Lealtad
            if (enchantment == Enchantments.f_44955_ && EquipmentPolicy.isTrident(item)) {
                if (EnchantmentHelper.m_44932_(stack) > 0) {
                    return;
                }
            }
            int innate = theoptimizer$getInnateLevel(enchantment, item);
            if (innate > 0 && cir.getReturnValue() < innate) {
                cir.setReturnValue(innate);
            }
        }
    }

    @Inject(method = "m_44831_", at = @At("RETURN"), cancellable = true)
    private static void theoptimizer$toolInnateEnchantmentsMap(ItemStack stack,
                                                               CallbackInfoReturnable<Map<Enchantment, Integer>> cir) {
        if (!EquipmentConfig.get().enable_tool_attributes) {
            return;
        }
        if (stack != null && !stack.m_41619_()) {
            Item item = stack.m_41720_();
            Map<Enchantment, Integer> map = cir.getReturnValue();
            Map<Enchantment, Integer> modifiable = null;

            // Toque de Seda (Diamante) y Fortuna III (Netherita) operan vía getItemEnchantmentLevel + ItemPredicateMixin
            // para no exponerse ni extraerse como encantamientos visibles del ítem.
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isNetheriteBoots(item)) {
                modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_44976_, 2);
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isLeatherBoots(item)) {
                modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_44967_, 4);
                Enchantment lw = ForgeRegistries.ENCHANTMENTS.getValue(ResourceLocation.m_135820_("passablefoliage:leaf_walker"));
                if (lw != null) {
                    modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, lw, 1);
                }
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isLeatherLeggings(item)) {
                modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_220304_, 3);
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isTurtleHelmet(item)) {
                modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_44970_, 3);
                modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_44971_, 1);
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isFlyingFishBoots(item)) {
                modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_44973_, 3);
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isRockyChestplate(item)) {
                modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_44972_, 3);
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isStone(item) && EquipmentPolicy.isCombatWeapon(item)) {
                modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_44980_, 1);
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isIron(item) && EquipmentPolicy.isSword(item)) {
                modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_44983_, 3);
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isGold(item) && EquipmentPolicy.isCombatWeapon(item)) {
                modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_44978_, EquipmentConfig.get().gold_smite_level);
            }
            if (EquipmentPolicy.isTrident(item)) {
                int riptide = map != null ? map.getOrDefault(Enchantments.f_44957_, 0) : 0;
                if (riptide <= 0) {
                    modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_44955_, 3);
                }
                modifiable = theoptimizer$putMin(map, modifiable, Enchantments.f_44956_, 5);
            }

            if (modifiable != null) {
                cir.setReturnValue(modifiable);
            }
        }

    @Inject(method = "m_220297_", at = @At("RETURN"))
    private static void theoptimizer$capSelectedEnchantmentLevels(RandomSource random, ItemStack stack, int level,
                                                                  boolean allowTreasure,
                                                                  CallbackInfoReturnable<List<EnchantmentInstance>> cir) {
        List<EnchantmentInstance> list = cir.getReturnValue();
        if (list != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
                EnchantmentInstance inst = list.get(i);
                if (inst.f_44947_ == Enchantments.f_44986_ || inst.f_44947_ == Enchantments.f_44982_
                    || inst.f_44947_ == Enchantments.f_44984_) {
                    if (inst.f_44948_ > 1) {
                        list.set(i, new EnchantmentInstance(inst.f_44947_, 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Unique
    private static Map<Enchantment, Integer> theoptimizer$putMin(Map<Enchantment, Integer> original,
                                                                 Map<Enchantment, Integer> current,
                                                                 Enchantment ench, int minLevel) {
        if (ench == null) {
            return current;
        }
        Map<Enchantment, Integer> target = current != null ? current : new LinkedHashMap<>(original != null ? original : Map.of());
        int existing = target.getOrDefault(ench, 0);
        if (existing < minLevel) {
            target.put(ench, minLevel);
        }
        return target;
    }
}

@Mixin(Enchantment.class)
public abstract class EnchantmentMixin {

    @Unique
    private boolean theoptimizer$isForbidden() {
        if (!EquipmentConfig.get().enable_tool_attributes) {
            return false;
        }
        Enchantment self = (Enchantment) (Object) this;

        // Silk Touch
        if (self instanceof UntouchingEnchantment || self == Enchantments.f_44985_) {
            return true;
        }
        // Block Fortune (Digger)
        if (self == Enchantments.f_44987_ ||
            (self instanceof LootBonusEnchantment && self.f_44672_ == EnchantmentCategory.DIGGER)) {
            return true;
        }
        // Protecciones
        if (self == Enchantments.f_44965_ // PROTECTION
            || self == Enchantments.f_44966_ // FIRE_PROTECTION
            || self == Enchantments.f_44967_ // FEATHER_FALLING
            || self == Enchantments.f_44968_ // BLAST_PROTECTION
            || self == Enchantments.f_44969_) { // PROJECTILE_PROTECTION
            return true;
        }
        // Maldiciones
        if (self == Enchantments.f_44975_ // BINDING_CURSE
            || self == Enchantments.f_44963_) { // VANISHING_CURSE
            return true;
        }
        // Utilidades y Armaduras
        if (self == Enchantments.f_44970_ // RESPIRATION
            || self == Enchantments.f_44971_ // AQUA_AFFINITY
            || self == Enchantments.f_44972_ // THORNS
            || self == Enchantments.f_44973_ // DEPTH_STRIDER
            || self == Enchantments.f_44974_ // FROST_WALKER
            || self == Enchantments.f_44976_ // SOUL_SPEED
            || self == Enchantments.f_220304_) { // SWIFT_SNEAK
            return true;
        }
        // Combate Melee
        if (self == Enchantments.f_44977_ // SHARPNESS
            || self == Enchantments.f_44978_ // SMITE
            || self == Enchantments.f_44979_ // BANE_OF_ARTHROPODS
            || self == Enchantments.f_44980_ // KNOCKBACK
            || self == Enchantments.f_44981_ // FIRE_ASPECT
            || self == Enchantments.f_44983_) { // SWEEPING_EDGE
            return true;
        }
        // Distancia / Rango
        if (self == Enchantments.f_44988_ // POWER
            || self == Enchantments.f_44989_ // PUNCH
            || self == Enchantments.f_44990_ // FLAME
            || self == Enchantments.f_44952_ // INFINITY
            || self == Enchantments.f_44959_ // MULTISHOT
            || self == Enchantments.f_44960_ // QUICK_CHARGE
            || self == Enchantments.f_44961_) { // PIERCING
            return true;
        }
        // Tridente y Pesca
        if (self == Enchantments.f_44955_ // LOYALTY
            || self == Enchantments.f_44956_ // IMPALING
            || self == Enchantments.f_44957_ // RIPTIDE
            || self == Enchantments.f_44958_ // CHANNELING
            || self == Enchantments.f_44953_ // LUCK_OF_THE_SEA
            || self == Enchantments.f_44954_) { // LURE
            return true;
        }
        // Reparación / Mending (inhabilitado por completo: no botín, no aldeanos, no libros, no mesa)
        if (self == Enchantments.f_44962_) { // MENDING
            return true;
        }

        // Mods a deshabilitar
        ResourceLocation id = ForgeRegistries.ENCHANTMENTS.getKey(self);
        if (id != null) {
            String ns = id.m_135827_();
            String path = id.m_135815_();
            if ("alexsmobs".equals(ns) && "lavawax".equals(path)) return true;
            if ("kaleidoscope_end".equals(ns)) {
                if ("void_walker".equals(path) || "void_assault".equals(path) || "void_echo".equals(path)) return true;
            }
            if ("kaleidoscope_nether".equals(ns)) {
                if ("blessing".equals(path) || "lava_walker".equals(path)) return true;
            }
            if ("kaleidoscopecookery".equals(ns)) {
                if ("quick_knife".equals(path) || "sweep".equals(path)) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Inject(method = "m_6592_", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true) // isDiscoverable()
    private void theoptimizer$enchantmentNotDiscoverable(CallbackInfoReturnable<Boolean> cir) {
        if (theoptimizer$isForbidden()) {
            cir.setReturnValue(false);
        }
    }

    @Inject(method = "m_6594_", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true) // isTradeable()
    private void theoptimizer$enchantmentNotTradeable(CallbackInfoReturnable<Boolean> cir) {
        Enchantment self = (Enchantment) (Object) this;
        if (EquipmentConfig.get().enable_tool_attributes && self == Enchantments.f_44984_) {
            cir.setReturnValue(false);
            return;
        }
        if (theoptimizer$isForbidden()) {
            cir.setReturnValue(false);
        }
    }

    @Inject(method = "canApplyAtEnchantingTable", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true, remap = false)
    private void theoptimizer$enchantmentEnchantingTable(ItemStack stack, CallbackInfoReturnable<Boolean> cir) {
        // La mesa de encantamientos es puramente decorativa e inerte; ningún encantamiento es aplicable en mesa.
        cir.setReturnValue(false);
    }

    @Inject(method = "isAllowedOnBooks", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true, remap = false)
    private void theoptimizer$enchantmentAllowedOnBooks(CallbackInfoReturnable<Boolean> cir) {
        Enchantment self = (Enchantment) (Object) this;
        // Eficiencia, Irrompibilidad y Botín SI están permitidos en libros para combinarse en el yunque
        if (self == Enchantments.f_44984_ || self == Enchantments.f_44986_ || self == Enchantments.f_44982_) {
            return;
        }
        if (theoptimizer$isForbidden()) {
            cir.setReturnValue(false);
        }
    }

    @Inject(method = "m_6081_", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true) // canEnchant(ItemStack)
    private void theoptimizer$enchantmentCanEnchant(ItemStack stack, CallbackInfoReturnable<Boolean> cir) {
        Enchantment self = (Enchantment) (Object) this;
        // Eficiencia es aplicable a herramientas de minería y libros en el yunque
        if (self == Enchantments.f_44984_ && stack != null
            && (stack.m_41720_() instanceof DiggerItem
                || stack.m_41720_() == Items.f_42517_
                || stack.m_41720_() == Items.f_42690_)) {
            return;
        }
        // Irrompibilidad y Botín en libros o items aplicables en el yunque
        if (self == Enchantments.f_44986_ || self == Enchantments.f_44982_) {
            return;
        }
        if (theoptimizer$isForbidden()) {
            cir.setReturnValue(false);
        }
    }
}

    private void theoptimizer$constantHealingTick(Player player, CallbackInfo ci) {

        if (!cfg.constant_healing) {

        }

        Difficulty difficulty = player.m_9236_().m_46791_();

        // Drenaje regular de agotamiento hacia saturación y hambre
        if (this.f_38698_ > 4.0F) {

            if (this.f_38697_ > 0.0F) {
                this.f_38697_ = Math.max(this.f_38697_ - 1.0F, 0.0F);
            } else if (difficulty != Difficulty.PEACEFUL) {
                this.f_38696_ = Math.max(this.f_38696_ - 1, 0);
            }
        }

        boolean naturalRegen = player.m_9236_().m_46469_().m_46207_(GameRules.f_46139_);

        // Curación constante: 1 HP cada N ticks mientras haya alimento y esté herido
        if (naturalRegen && this.f_38696_ > 0 && player.m_36325_()) {
            this.f_38699_++;
            if (this.f_38699_ >= cfg.constant_heal_interval_ticks) {
                player.m_5634_(1.0F);
                this.m_38703_(cfg.constant_heal_exhaustion);
                this.f_38699_ = 0;
            }
        } else if (this.f_38696_ <= 0) {
            this.f_38699_++;
            if (this.f_38699_ >= 80) {
                if (player.m_21223_() > 10.0F || difficulty == Difficulty.HARD || (player.m_21223_() > 1.0F && difficulty == Difficulty.NORMAL)) {
                    player.m_6469_(player.m_269291_().m_269064_(), 1.0F);
                }
                this.f_38699_ = 0;
            }
        } else {
            this.f_38699_ = 0;
        }

        ci.cancel();
    }
