```java
@Mixin(GrindstoneMenu.class)
public abstract class GrindstoneExtractionMixin {

    @Inject(method = "m_39593_", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void theoptimizer$ignorarInnatos(CallbackInfo ci) {
        if (!EquipmentConfig.get().grindstone_extraction) {
            return;
        }
        AbstractContainerMenu menu = (AbstractContainerMenu) (Object) this;
        boolean hayEncantamiento = false;
        boolean hayLooteable = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            Slot ranura = menu.m_38853_(i);
            if (ranura == null || !ranura.m_6657_()) {
                continue;
            }
            ItemStack stack = ranura.m_7993_();
            if (stack.m_41619_()) {
                continue;
            }
            Map<Enchantment, Integer> encantamientos = EnchantmentHelper.m_44831_(stack);
            if (encantamientos.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            hayEncantamiento = true;
            for (Enchantment encantamiento : encantamientos.keySet()) {
                if (esLooteable(encantamiento)) {
                    hayLooteable = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (hayEncantamiento && !hayLooteable) {
            // Solo hay innatos: la muela no hace nada y no cobra XP.
            Slot salida = menu.m_38853_(2);
            if (salida != null) {
                salida.m_5852_(ItemStack.f_41583_);
            }
            ci.cancel();
        }
    }

    @Inject(method = "m_39593_", at = @At("RETURN"))
    private void theoptimizer$extraerEncantamiento(CallbackInfo ci) {
        if (!EquipmentConfig.get().grindstone_extraction) {
            return;
        }
        AbstractContainerMenu menu = (AbstractContainerMenu) (Object) this;
        Slot salida = menu.m_38853_(2);
        if (salida == null || !salida.m_6657_()) {
            return;
        }

        Enchantment elegido = null;
        int nivelElegido = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            Slot ranura = menu.m_38853_(i);
            if (ranura == null || !ranura.m_6657_()) {
                continue;
            }
            ItemStack entrada = ranura.m_7993_();
            if (entrada.m_41619_()) {
                continue;
            }
            Map<Enchantment, Integer> encantamientos = EnchantmentHelper.m_44831_(entrada);
            for (Map.Entry<Enchantment, Integer> entry : encantamientos.entrySet()) {
                if (esLooteable(entry.getKey())) {
                    elegido = entry.getKey();
                    nivelElegido = Math.max(1, entry.getValue() != null ? entry.getValue() : 1);
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (elegido != null) {
                break;
            }
        }
        if (elegido == null) {
            salida.m_5852_(ItemStack.f_41583_);
            return;
        }

        ItemStack libro = new ItemStack(Items.f_42690_);
        EnchantedBookItem.m_41153_(libro, new EnchantmentInstance(elegido, nivelElegido));
        salida.m_5852_(libro);
    }

    /** Solo los tres encantamientos que existen en el pack como botín. */
    private static boolean esLooteable(Enchantment encantamiento) {
        return encantamiento == Enchantments.f_44986_  // Irrompibilidad
            || encantamiento == Enchantments.f_44982_   // Botín
            || encantamiento == Enchantments.f_44984_;  // Eficiencia
    }
}
```

```java
@Mixin(ItemStack.class)
public abstract class ItemStackMixin {

    @ModifyVariable(method = "m_220157_", at = @At("HEAD"), argsOnly = true, ordinal = 0)
    private int theoptimizer$halveIronToolDurabilityLoss(int amount) {
        if (MiningDurability.suppressed((ItemStack) (Object) this)) return 0;
        if (amount <= 0 || !EquipmentConfig.get().enable_tool_attributes) {
            return amount;
        }
        ItemStack self = (ItemStack) (Object) this;
        if (!EquipmentPolicy.isIronHarvestTool(self.m_41720_())) {
            return amount;
        }
        int halved = amount / 2;
        if ((amount & 1) == 1 && ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextBoolean()) {
            halved++;
        }
        return halved;
    }
}
```

```java
        }

    /**
     * Durabilidad base por tier: 80 (madera) -> 160 (piedra) -> 300 (hierro/oro).

     */

        EquipmentConfig cfg = EquipmentConfig.get();
        if ((Object) this == Tiers.WOOD) {
            cir.setReturnValue(cfg.wood_tool_durability);
        } else if ((Object) this == Tiers.STONE) {
            cir.setReturnValue(cfg.stone_tool_durability);
        } else if ((Object) this == Tiers.IRON) {
            cir.setReturnValue(cfg.iron_tool_durability);
        } else if ((Object) this == Tiers.GOLD) {
            cir.setReturnValue(cfg.gold_tools_durability);
        }
    }

    @Inject(method = "m_6624_", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void theoptimizer$unifiedSpeed(CallbackInfoReturnable<Float> cir) {
        cir.setReturnValue(EquipmentConfig.get().unified_harvest_speed);
    }

    @Inject(method = "m_6631_", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void theoptimizer$goldAttackDamageBonus(CallbackInfoReturnable<Float> cir) {
        if ((Object) this == Tiers.GOLD && EquipmentConfig.get().gold_is_iron_tier) {
            cir.setReturnValue(2.0F); // Paridad plana con hierro: Espada 6.0 / Hacha 9.0
        }
    }

    @Inject(method = "m_6601_", at = @At("HEAD"), cancellable = true)
    private void theoptimizer$diamondEnchantmentValue(CallbackInfoReturnable<Integer> cir) {
        if ((Object) this == Tiers.DIAMOND) {
            cir.setReturnValue(15); // Rebalance de encantabilidad: sube de 10 a 15
        } else if ((Object) this == Tiers.STONE) {
            cir.setReturnValue(EquipmentConfig.get().basic_enchantability); // Piedra: 5 -> 8
        }
    }
}
```

```java
@Mod.EventBusSubscriber(modid = EquipmentMod.MODID, bus = Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.FORGE)
public final class ToolInnatesEvents {

    private static final float WOOD_BONEMEAL_CHANCE = EquipmentValues.WOOD_BONEMEAL_CHANCE;
    private static final int AREA_RADIUS = (EquipmentValues.IRON_MINING_WIDTH - 1) / 2;
    private static final ThreadLocal<Boolean> BREAKING_AREA = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> Boolean.FALSE);
    private static final Map<UUID, HitFace> LAST_HIT_FACE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private record HitFace(BlockPos pos, Direction face) {
    }

    private ToolInnatesEvents() {
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onLeftClickBlock(PlayerInteractEvent.LeftClickBlock event) {
        if (event.getLevel().m_5776_() || event.getFace() == null || event.getEntity() == null) {
            return;
        }
        LAST_HIT_FACE.put(event.getEntity().m_20148_(), new HitFace(event.getPos().m_7949_(), event.getFace()));
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onBlockBreak(BlockEvent.BreakEvent event) {
        if (event.isCanceled() || BREAKING_AREA.get() || !EquipmentConfig.get().enable_tool_attributes) {
            return;
        }
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        if (player == null || player.m_7500_() || player.m_5833_()) {
            return;
        }
        if (!(event.getLevel() instanceof ServerLevel level)) {
            return;
        }
        ItemStack tool = player.m_21205_();
        if (tool.m_41619_()) {
            return;
        }
        Item item = tool.m_41720_();
        if (!esHerramientaCompleta(item)) {
            return;
        }
        BlockPos pos = event.getPos();
        BlockState state = event.getState();

        if (EquipmentPolicy.isWood(item)) {
            if (esVegetal(state) && player.m_217043_().m_188501_() < WOOD_BONEMEAL_CHANCE) {
                Block.m_49840_(level, pos, new ItemStack(Items.f_42499_)); // Items.BONE_MEAL
            }
            return;
        }

        if (EquipmentPolicy.isGold(item)) {
            if (!state.m_155947_() && esHerramientaEficiente(tool, state)) {
                List<ItemStack> drops = Block.m_49874_(state, level, pos, null, player, tool);
                List<ItemStack> procesados = new ArrayList<>(drops.size());
                boolean algoFundido = false;
                for (ItemStack drop : drops) {
                    ItemStack fundido = buscarFundicion(level, drop);
                    if (fundido != null) {
                        procesados.add(fundido);
                        algoFundido = true;
                    } else {
                        procesados.add(drop);
                    }
                }
                if (algoFundido) {
                    event.setCanceled(true);
                    level.m_7471_(pos, false);
                    for (ItemStack dropFinal : procesados) {
                        Block.m_49840_(level, pos, dropFinal);
                    }
                    if (!esHojaSinDesgaste(state) && state.m_60800_(level, pos) != 0.0F) {
                        tool.m_41622_(1, player, p -> p.m_21166_(EquipmentSlot.MAINHAND));
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        if (EquipmentPolicy.isIron(item) && EquipmentCombatRules.areaMining(true, player.m_36341_())
            && player instanceof ServerPlayer serverPlayer) {
            List<BlockPos> area = areaDeRotura(level, pos, state, serverPlayer, tool);
            if (!area.isEmpty()) {
                BREAKING_AREA.set(Boolean.TRUE);
                try {
                    for (BlockPos objetivo : area) {
                        if (tool.m_41619_() || serverPlayer.m_21205_() != tool) {
                            break;
                        }
                        serverPlayer.f_8941_.m_9280_(objetivo);
                    }
                } finally {
                    BREAKING_AREA.set(Boolean.FALSE);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean esHerramientaCompleta(Item item) {
        return item instanceof DiggerItem;
    }

    private static boolean esHerramientaEficiente(ItemStack tool, BlockState state) {
        return tool.m_41735_(state) && tool.m_41691_(state) > 1.0F;
    }

    private static boolean esHojaSinDesgaste(BlockState state) {
        if (!EquipmentConfig.get().leaves_free_durability) {
            return false;
        }
        return state.m_204336_(BlockTags.f_13035_);
    }

    private static boolean esVegetal(BlockState state) {
        if (state.m_204336_(BlockTags.f_13106_)   // LOGS
            || state.m_204336_(BlockTags.f_13035_) // LEAVES
            || state.m_204336_(BlockTags.f_13073_) // CROPS
            || state.m_204336_(BlockTags.f_13104_) // SAPLINGS
            || state.m_204336_(BlockTags.f_13041_)) { // FLOWERS
            return true;
        }
        var key = ForgeRegistries.BLOCKS.getKey(state.m_60734_());
        if (key == null) {
            return false;
        }
        String id = key.m_135815_();
        return id.contains("grass") || id.contains("sapling") || id.contains("vine")
            || id.contains("bamboo") || id.contains("sugar_cane") || id.contains("pumpkin")
            || id.contains("melon") || id.contains("mushroom") || id.contains("crop")
            || id.contains("wart");
    }

    private static ItemStack buscarFundicion(ServerLevel level, ItemStack drop) {
        if (drop.m_41619_()) {
            return null;
        }
        Optional<SmeltingRecipe> receta = level.m_7465_().m_44015_(RecipeType.f_44108_, new SimpleContainer(drop), level);
        if (receta.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        ItemStack base = receta.get().m_8043_(level.m_9598_());
        if (base.m_41619_()) {
            return null;
        }
        ItemStack resultado = base.m_41777_();
        resultado.m_41764_(Math.max(1, drop.m_41613_() * base.m_41613_()));
        return resultado;
    }

    private static List<BlockPos> areaDeRotura(ServerLevel level, BlockPos centro, BlockState centroState,
                                               ServerPlayer player, ItemStack tool) {
        float hardness = centroState.m_60800_(level, centro);
        if (hardness < 0.0F || (!esHerramientaEficiente(tool, centroState) && !(tool.m_41720_() instanceof HoeItem && esVegetal(centroState)))) {
            return List.of();
        }
        int eje = resolverEjeRotura(level, centro, centroState, player, tool);
        List<BlockPos> area = new ArrayList<>(8);
        for (int a = -AREA_RADIUS; a <= AREA_RADIUS; a++) {
            for (int b = -AREA_RADIUS; b <= AREA_RADIUS; b++) {
                if (a == 0 && b == 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                BlockPos objetivo = switch (eje) {
                    case 0 -> centro.m_7918_(0, a, b);
                    case 1 -> centro.m_7918_(a, 0, b);
                    default -> centro.m_7918_(a, b, 0);
                };
                BlockState estado = level.m_8055_(objetivo);
                if (estado.m_60795_() || estado.m_60734_() instanceof LiquidBlock || estado.m_204336_(BlockTags.f_13070_)) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (level.m_7702_(objetivo) != null) {
                    continue;
                }
                float dureza = estado.m_60800_(level, objetivo);
                if (dureza < 0.0F) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (hardness == 0.0F) {
                    if (dureza == 0.0F && (esHerramientaEficiente(tool, estado) || (tool.m_41720_() instanceof HoeItem && esVegetal(estado)))) {
                        area.add(objetivo);
                    }
                } else if (dureza > 0.0F && dureza <= Math.max(hardness, 1.5F) * 2.0F && esHerramientaEficiente(tool, estado)) {
                    area.add(objetivo);
                }
            }
        }
        return area;
    }

    private static int resolverEjeRotura(ServerLevel level, BlockPos centro, BlockState centroState,
                                         ServerPlayer player, ItemStack tool) {
        if (centroState.m_60800_(level, centro) == 0.0F && tool.m_41720_() instanceof HoeItem) {
            return 1; // Cosecha 3x3 horizontal sobre cultivos aunque se mire inclinado
        }

        // 1. Cara exacta del impacto registrada al empezar a picar el bloque
        HitFace ultimo = LAST_HIT_FACE.remove(player.m_20148_());
        if (ultimo != null && ultimo.pos().equals(centro)) {
            return ejeDesdeCara(ultimo.face());
        }

        // 2. Raycast desde los ojos del jugador al bloque para obtener la cara real impactada
        double alcance = Math.max(4.5D, player.m_21133_(ForgeMod.BLOCK_REACH.get()) + 1.0D);
        Vec3 ojos = player.m_146892_();
        Vec3 dir = player.m_20252_(1.0F);
        Vec3 fin = ojos.m_82549_(dir.m_82490_(alcance));
        BlockHitResult ray = level.m_45547_(new ClipContext(ojos, fin, ClipContext.Block.OUTLINE, ClipContext.Fluid.NONE, player));
        if (ray.m_6662_() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK && ray.m_82425_().equals(centro)) {
            return ejeDesdeCara(ray.m_82434_());
        }

        // 3. Respaldo por angulo de mirada
        double[] vista = {player.m_20154_().f_82479_, player.m_20154_().f_82480_, player.m_20154_().f_82481_};
        if (Math.abs(vista[0]) >= Math.abs(vista[1]) && Math.abs(vista[0]) >= Math.abs(vista[2])) {
            return 0;
        }
        if (Math.abs(vista[1]) >= Math.abs(vista[2])) {
            return 1;
        }
        return 2;
    }

    private static int ejeDesdeCara(Direction face) {
        return switch (face.m_122434_()) {
            case X -> 0;
            case Y -> 1;
            case Z -> 2;
        };
    }
}
```

```java
public final class TooltipComponents {
    private TooltipComponents() { }

    public static Component modifier(Component text) {
        if (text.m_214077_() instanceof TranslatableContents t && t.m_237508_().startsWith("attribute.modifier.")) return text;
        for (Component child : text.m_7360_()) {
            Component found = modifier(child);
            if (found != null) return found;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static String attributeKey(Component text) {
        if (text.m_214077_() instanceof TranslatableContents t) {
            String key = t.m_237508_();
            if (key.startsWith("attribute.name.") || key.equals("forge.entity_reach") || key.equals("forge.block_reach")) return key;
            for (Object argument : t.m_237523_()) if (argument instanceof Component c) {
                String found = attributeKey(c);
                if (found != null) return found;
            }
        }
        for (Component child : text.m_7360_()) {
            String found = attributeKey(child);
            if (found != null) return found;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static boolean replaced(Component line, Set<String> ownedAttributes) {
        Component modifier = modifier(line);
        String key = modifier == null ? null : attributeKey(modifier);
        return key != null && ownedAttributes.contains(key);
    }

    public static Component align(Component line) {
        Component modifier = modifier(line);
        // No quitar prefijos o anotaciones de otros mods.
        if (modifier == null || !line.getString().strip().equals(modifier.getString().strip())) return line;
        return Component.m_237113_(" ").m_7220_(modifier.m_6881_().m_130948_(line.m_7383_()));
    }
}
```

```java
public final class TooltipText {
    public static final float TICKS_PER_SECOND = 20;
    public static final float HEALTH_PER_HEART = 2;
    public static final float EXHAUSTION_PER_DRUMSTICK = 8;
    private TooltipText() { }
    public static String number(double value) {
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.2f", value).replaceAll("0+$", "").replaceAll("\\.$", "").replace('.', ',');
    }
    public static String percent(double fraction) { return number(fraction * 100) + "%"; }
    public static String seconds(int ticks) { return number(ticks / TICKS_PER_SECOND) + " s"; }
    public static String hearts(float damage) { return number(damage / HEALTH_PER_HEART); }
    public static String food(float exhaustion) { return number(exhaustion / EXHAUSTION_PER_DRUMSTICK); }
}
```

## 11. Verificación posterior

Se ejecutó packwiz refresh. El verificador usó -SkipTests: no cambió código/artefacto de EquipmentBalance y no se recompiló el módulo ni se volvió a ejecutar su suite JVM. La medición de atributos de este reporte procede de la ejecución aislada descrita arriba.

```text
OK   pack.integridad            361 entradas, 0 con hash incorrecto
OK   pack.entradas              361/361
OK   pack.eol                   sin CRLF en archivos de texto
OK   mod.version                jar=1.24.2 esperado=1.24.2
OK   jar.paridad                repo=086f7f61e5c1 servidor=086f7f61e5c1 indice=086f7f61e5c1
OK   jar.mobs                   repo=b147e6c182d5 servidor=b147e6c182d5 indice=b147e6c182d5
OK   config.claves              104/104 claves
OK   config.valores             coinciden
SKIP tests.modulo               omitido (-SkipTests)
OK   C1.sin-encantamientos      tooltips solo describen efectos
OK   C2.linaje-netherita        ignitium/cursium/monstrous/mage presentes
OK   C3.tunicas-pagan           irons + alexs_caves en rol mago
SKIP pages.version              no comprobable: No such host is known. (drox17.github.io:443)
OK   loot.registro              27/27 tablas sin cambios
FAIL git.limpio                 hay cambios sin commitear

RESUMEN 15/16 - derivas: git.limpio
```

git.limpio falla por los cambios locales autorizados y el reporte nuevo. Pages no pudo consultarse por DNS en ese entorno. No se afirmó que 15/16 signifique que todos los equipables cumplan C1–C6. TheOptimizerMods permanece sin cambios de trabajo. No se publicó la retirada.
